acquisition.also_preserved: schedule identities (home/away team ids and abbrevs, start) needed for target home/away and chronology; OT TOI (ot_toi_sec) when the source supplies it
acquisition.frozen_dataset: deterministic per-season gzip JSONL files + manifest with sha256; split by season; the research input is reproduced from the committed frozen dataset only. The repo skater_games table is NOT used.
acquisition.method: Phase 0B M2 only: NHL schedule (api-web schedule/{date}, regular season) + stats-REST skater/summary (isGame=true, gameDate window, gameTypeId=2) + stats-REST skater/timeonice (same), no team filter; weekly 7-day windows
acquisition.provenance: per window: URL/query identity, retrieval timestamp, sha256, bytes, reported total, returned rows, window dates
acquisition.window_guard: reported total < 10000 AND returned rows == reported total, for every window; a failing window BLOCKS the phase (no silent expansion to another query strategy)

bootstrap.blocks: calendar weeks Monday 00:00 UTC - Sunday 23:59 UTC from target start (dependence only, never a feature)
bootstrap.scheme: 2-consecutive-calendar-week moving-block bootstrap: valid start positions i with weeks i,i+1 present, blocks sampled with replacement until the season's calendar-week count is covered, trimmed to length, mean of all game deltas in the sampled weeks
bootstrap.unit: game-level mean CRPS difference (challenger - reference, lower is better)

bug_policy: a coding bug may be fixed without changing a registered scientific rule; any clarification is recorded in this file before scoring

confirmation_2024.failure: record exact failed gates; no rescue tuning
confirmation_2024.fit: B0/B1/B2/B3 on targets 2018-2023 with frozen dev hyperparameters; score 2024 once
confirmation_2024.freeze: the final incumbent is the FROZEN 2024-selected architecture; phase1a_2024_confirmation.json and phase1a_selected_architecture.json are COMMITTED before any 2025 performance is inspected

gates.G2: one-sided 95% blocked-bootstrap upper bound of delta CRPS (challenger - incumbent) < 0
gates.G3: macro-game NLL not worse by more than 0.5% relative
gates.G4: |80% coverage - 0.8| and |90% coverage - 0.9| each not worse than the incumbent's by > 0.02 absolute
gates.G5: PIT KS not worse than incumbent by > 0.02 absolute
gates.G6: no POSITION slice F or D with >=500 prediction rows has CRPS > 5% worse than incumbent
gates.G7: neither early-season rows (N_CURRENT_SEASON_TEAM_GAMES_OBS <= 10) nor established rows (> 10) with >=500 rows has CRPS > 5% worse than incumbent

block_before_modeling_if_any_fails: every target game resolves in the schedule
every source game satisfies the completed-before cutoff
target game id excluded from all feature histories
ordering by actual UTC start (never the repo synthetic week)
nonnegative TOI / shift values where present
M2 truncation guards pass for every window
no sportsbook columns in model data
position from the latest PRIOR same-team appearance, never the target game
candidate and unobservable coverage reported by season

toi_quality.block: present-but-inconsistent rows > 0.2% in any research season (2017-2025)
toi_quality.rule: for fully observed rows require EV+PP+SH(+OT if supplied) within 1 second of total TOI; missingness is reported separately; missing conditional-performance values are never silently converted to zero

development.inspection: 2024 and 2025 are not inspected during this step
development.selection_metric: mean over D1-D4 of fold-level MACRO-GAME CRPS (within a game: mean CRPS over that game's candidate rows; within a fold: mean over games; across folds: equal weight)
development.tie_rule: within 0.1% relative CRPS choose STRONGER regularization (Poisson: larger alpha; logistic: smaller C); B3 pair: minimise unconditional B3 CRPS, tie -> smaller C, then larger Poisson alpha

execution_order: acquire the frozen dataset + data-quality gates (stop on failure)

AVAILABILITY_MEMBERSHIP: PLAY_RATE_TG3 = appearances in last <=3 prior team games / available prior team games in that window
ENVIRONMENT: TEAM_SOG_FOR_MEAN5 (team official SOG over last <=5 completed team games)
OPP_SOG_ALLOWED_MEAN5 (target opponent's SOG allowed over its last <=5 completed games)
feature_contract.POSITION: latest PRIOR same-team appearance; POS_F (C/L/R/F), POS_D (D), POS_UNKNOWN
feature_contract.PP_allocation_share: player PP TOI / sum of all team skater PP TOI in that prior game (allocation share, not true PP opportunity share)
SKILL (any team, completed before T): SOG_PER60_APP10 = 3600*SUM(SOG over last <=10 appearances)/SUM(total TOI seconds over those appearances) (ratio of sums)
TARGET_SCHEDULE: TEAM_REST_HOURS = target start - previous team game start (schedule); raw kept, capped at 240 for regression input only
feature_contract.excluded: no shot attempts, no goalie identity, no linemate overlap, no extra 3/5/10 variants in Phase 1A

implementation_clarifications_recorded_b.DAYS_SINCE_LAST_APPEARANCE: (target start - start of the player's last prior appearance for the current team) in days
implementation_clarifications_recorded_b.N_CURRENT_SEASON_PLAYER_APPEARANCES: the player's completed prior appearances in the target season for ANY team (player-level count)
implementation_clarifications_recorded_b.N_CURRENT_SEASON_TEAM_GAMES_OBS: the target team's completed prior games in the target season
implementation_clarifications_recorded_b.SOG_SD_APP10: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of SOG over the last <=10 appearances; missing when fewer than 2
implementation_clarifications_recorded_b.TEAM_GAMES_SINCE_APPEARANCE: number of the team's prior completed games after the player's last appearance for that team (0 = played the last team game)
implementation_clarifications_recorded_b.TEAM_REST_HOURS_first_game: missing when the team has no earlier game in the loaded schedule
implementation_clarifications_recorded_b.availability_domain: all AVAILABILITY_MEMBERSHIP features use appearances FOR THE CURRENT TARGET TEAM and that team's completed prior games (the membership domain); the denominator is prior TEAM games.
implementation_clarifications_recorded_b.football_free: no other clarification changes a scientific rule
implementation_clarifications_recorded_b.missing_components: role means skip appearances whose component is missing; a feature with no usable appearance is missing (NaN) and handled by the registered imputation + indicator; a team with zero PP time gives an undefined (missing) allocation share
implementation_clarifications_recorded_b.team_official_SOG: team SOG of a game = sum of its skaters' shots (verified equal to the boxscore team SOG in Phase 0A)

forbidden: sportsbook / odds / projections / rankings / articles / market data
target-game roster / boxscore / TOI / PP / shifts / position / SOG / PBP as features
XGBoost / LightGBM / neural nets / state-space models
any change of features, grids, gates, architecture after inspecting 2024 results; any tuning / rescue after 2025 is inspected

holdout_2025.fit: refit every frozen architecture on targets 2018-2024 with identical architecture, hyperparameters, preprocessing procedure, dispersion method; no new feature, no calibration rescue; score 2025 exactly once

gates_vs_B0.H4: 80% and 90% coverage calibration error not worse than B0 by > 0.02
gates_vs_B0.H5: PIT KS not worse than B0 by > 0.02
gates_vs_B0.H6: F/D and early/established slices with >=500 rows have no > 5% CRPS degradation vs B0

holdout_2025.if_2024_selected_B0: 2025 is still scored for all frozen architectures and reported; the status is NO_HISTORICAL_PROMOTION
holdout_2025.promotion_reference_guardrail: if the selected architecture was promoted over another incumbent in 2024, its 2025 CRPS must be <= that promotion-reference model's 2025 CRPS (observed non-inferiority only)

status.fail: NO_HISTORICAL_PROMOTION; B0 remains the historical comparator; never switch to another model, never tune, never rerun 2025
status.pass: HISTORICAL_CHAMPION (historical only; forward deployment remains blocked by Phase 0B live timing evidence)

locked_inputs: Phase 0A/0B (historical information + acquisition contract) are LOCKED and are not modified to improve results.

B0.conditional_pmf: P(Y=k|play) = (n_player_k + KAPPA_SOG*q_position_k)/(n_player_appearances + KAPPA_SOG); n from the player's last <=10 prior appearances on any team; q = training-only empirical SOG PMF of PLAYED target rows of the position class on 0..60, smoothed with DIRICHLET_EPS per cell then normalized
B0.p_play: (plays_in_last_10_prior_team_games + KAPPA_PLAY*position_training_base_play_rate)/(n_available_prior_team_games_up_to_10 + KAPPA_PLAY); position classes F, D, UNKNOWN; empty class -> global training prior

B1.model: sklearn PoissonRegressor on ALL candidate rows, target sog_target_unconditional, all CORE features

B2.dispersion: alpha fitted by maximum likelihood on TRAINING rows with mu fixed, within [1e-6, 20] (bound hits reported); Var = mu + alpha*mu^2; scipy r = 1/alpha, p = r/(r+mu)
B2.model: NB2 wrapper around the selected B1 mean; no new regression mean

conditional.dispersion: conditional NB2 alpha by the same fixed-mean MLE on training PLAYED rows
conditional.model: sklearn PoissonRegressor on candidate rows who ACTUALLY PLAYED, target actual SOG

B3.mixture: P(0) = (1-p_play)+p_play*NB2(0|mu_play,alpha); P(k>0) = p_play*NB2(k|mu_play,alpha); no hurdle; a player may play with 0 SOG

population.games: regular-season NHL games only (gameTypeId=2); season = START year (2017 = 2017-18 ... 2025 = 2025-26)
population.phase0a_note: Phase 0A's tiny deterministic 2025 feasibility sample (a few games, game ids 2025020719 and 2025020444) was DATA-INTEGRITY exposure only (ID / SOG / TOI / shift agreement across sources), not performance or model selection.

reference_cutoff.definition: T = final historical scheduled start - 90 minutes
reference_cutoff.name: HISTORICAL_PRIOR_GAME_ONLY_T90_REFERENCE
reference_cutoff.not_a_claim: this does NOT validate T90 as the forward serving horizon; it only enforces a deterministic pregame cutoff for completed prior games
reference_cutoff.source_rule: source_start + 210 minutes <= T and source_game_id != target_game_id (Phase 0B)

roles.2017: history / warm-up only; no 2017 target row enters fitting or scoring
roles.2018-2023: development: rolling-origin model and hyperparameter selection
roles.2024: architecture confirmation; may NOT change feature definitions, grids, gates or architecture after inspection
roles.2025: untouched final historical holdout; burned once inspected; no rescue tuning, no model switch

evaluation.secondary: candidate rows who actually played; conditional performance can never rescue a model that fails the unconditional population

labels.played_target: 1 if the candidate appears in the target game else 0
labels.sog_target_unconditional: actual SOG if played else 0 (a candidate who sits out realizes 0)

prediction_unit.rows: one row per Phase 0B candidate_universe member of each target TEAM-game (target seasons 2018-2025)
prediction_unit.unobservable_at_T: actual target participants absent from the candidate universe: excluded from prediction rows; coverage (players and SOG) and diagnostics reported

preprocessing_learned_models.numeric: training-only median imputation, explicit missing indicator for every continuous numeric feature, training-only mean/std standardization of continuous features; binary indicators (POS_*, PLAYED_LAST1, IS_HOME, BACK_TO_BACK) stay 0/1; rows are never dropped for a missing lagged role feature; persisted: feature order, medians, means/stds, missing-indicator schema, training population hash

scope: SOG only. Target = full unconditional integer distribution P(player SOG = k). Thresholds P(SOG>=k) are derived afterwards; no sportsbook threshold, line, odds, projection, ranking, article or market data enters training or prediction. No goals/assists/points/saves/team models.

also_reported: central 50/80/90% interval coverage (interval [smallest k with F(k)>=(1-c)/2, smallest k with F(k)>=(1+c)/2]; calibration error = |coverage - nominal|)
deterministic randomized PIT u = F(y-1)+v*P(y), v = first 8 bytes of SHA256(model_id|game_id|player_id)/2^64; KS distance to Uniform(0,1)
threshold diagnostics P(SOG>=1..5): Brier + 10 equal-count-bin reliability / ECE (not selection targets)
B3: participation Brier + log loss, conditional-on-playing CRPS and NLL
scoring.crps: discrete: sum_{k>=0}[F(k)-1{y<=k}]^2; parametric support extended until k>=y and survival <1e-10, hard ceiling k=200 (survival >=1e-10 at 200 -> distribution invalid -> BLOCK); B0 support 0..60
scoring.nll: -log P(Y=y) with numerical floor 1e-15, every floor hit counted and reported
